metropt3.role: consumed development data; not independent confirmation

skab.role: consumed development data; not independent confirmation

protocol.component_p_values: empirical upper-tail ranks on the existing calibration split
protocol.fusion: combined scores are recalibrated on the same calibration split; no independence guarantee claimed
protocol.score_only_policy: same thresholds with every action forced to score and new_state_alert disabled; used only for comparable score fusion

variants.actcorr: base plus beta=0.05 off-diagonal activation-correlation penalty
variants.base: CNN d=32, epochs=90, maxavg pooling, ortho_beta=0.05
variants.swa: base plus arithmetic encoder-weight mean over epochs 60-90; SWA-inspired rather than a canonical SWA learning-rate schedule

study: CNN activation decorrelation, weight averaging, seed ensembling, and DSP late fusion
